record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, reduce embedding width from 64 to 48, retaining two heads, tied history/candidate embeddings, initialization and normalization rules. Width 96 regressed; a smaller representation may regularize sparse item estimates and reduce overfitting. Propagate width through existing HSTU layers, positions and checkpoint metadata without changing block count, feature definitions, history policy, readout, scoring formula, loss or optimizer. Keep predictor shapes consistent.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce embedding width from 64 to 48 across all four category models to test whether smaller representations regularize sparse item estimates. Retain two heads, tied embeddings, initialization, normalization, and existing HSTU topology. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the width consistently.
